blocks.content: SEBI lays down rules regarding structure, disclosure, and operation of mutual funds to ensure investor safety.
SEBI lays down rules regarding structure, disclosure, and operation of mutual funds to ensure investor safety.

items: SEBI regulates mutual funds across three key pillars: structure, disclosure, and operation.
The primary mandate of SEBI's mutual fund regulations is ensuring investor safety.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: SEBI is the primary regulatory body governing mutual funds in India.
SEBI's rules encompass the structure, disclosure practices, and overall operational aspects of mutual funds.
The overarching goal of SEBI's regulatory framework is to protect investor interests and ensure safety.
